capabilities: Open today's daily or periodic note in a new pane via command or sidebar button
Find and focus an already-open daily note instead of opening a duplicate
Configure an end-of-day time so notes open correctly around midnight
Append a new line to a specific section after opening the note
Colorize the daily note pane background via Style Settings
extras: Usage sections are empty headings without steps or screenshots; background colorization requires installing and enabling Style Settings, and the Style Settings section may need the plugin toggled off and on to appear.
intentEvidence: gives extra control over the behavior of daily notes
problem: Obsidian's daily notes feature opens today's note in the current pane with no hotkey-friendly command, no reuse of an already-open note, and no visual distinction for the pane.

relations.evidence: if Daily Notes in the Periodic Notes plugin is enabled, it will use settings from Periodic Notes
this functionality relies on another plugin called "Style Settings"
This project is made possible by the community surrounding it and especially the wonderful projects

summary: Daily notes helper that opens daily and periodic notes in a new pane, appends lines to them, and colorizes their background.
